title: Bangladesh
subtitle: Apparel sourcing: costs and risks
meta: Edition of 12 November 2026. Series to {series}, scores of 1 November in the appendix.
excerpt: Bangladesh reaches the end of 2026 with its labour cost, its political order and its energy bill in question at the same time. The external accounts are sounder than two years ago, with reserves near USD 30 billion and remittances at record levels, but the war in the Gulf has doubled the cost of fuel imports, the garment minimum wage is under revision with a demand of Tk 30,000 against the current 12,500, and a series of attacks precedes the announced return of the former prime minister.
